In the following question, select the related number from the given alternatives.

19 : 60 : : 21 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed is:

**Logic: (First number + 1) × 3 = Second number**

19: 60 → (19 + 1) × 3 = 60

Similarly,

21 : ? → (21 + 1) × 3 = 66

Hence, the correct answer is **"66".**

questions.question: Present ages of R and P are in the ratio of 9 : 11 respectively. After 7 years, their ages will be in the ratio of 26 : 31 and sum of their ages will be 114 years. What is the present age (in years) of P?
questions.solution:
Let us consider the age of R and P to be 9x: 11x, after 7 years their age will be (9x + 5) and (11x + 5) which is equal to a ratio 26: 31.

So by comparing that we will get,

(9x + 7) : (11x + 7) = 26 : 31

31 (9x + 7) = 26 (11x + 7)

279x + 217 = 286x + 182

217 - 182 = 286x - 279x

X = 5

Therefore x = 5, then the present age of P will be 11x = 11 × 5 = 55.

Hence, the correct answer is **"55".**

In a certain code language, '÷' represents ' + ', '-' represents ' × ', ' + ' represents '÷' and ' × ' represents '-'. Find out the answer to the following question.

17 - 20 + 5 × 30 ÷ 4 = ?
questions.solution:

questions.solution:

Checking options one by one by interchanging signs

1) ÷ and ×

After interchanging, new equation → 16 ÷ 4 - 10 + 10 × 6 = 54

By solving the equation using BODMAS Rule, we get:-

__**16 ÷ 4**__ - 10 + 10 × 6 = 54

4 - 10 + __**10 × 6**__ = 54

__**4**__ - 10 __**+ 60**__ = 54

64 - 10 = 54

54 = 54

questions.question: If 9 & 4 = 50, 3 & 7 = -40 and 7 & 5 = 20, then ﬁnd the value of 4 & 5 = ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:-

(First number - Second number) × 10 = Result.

In 9 & 4 = 50

(9 - 4) × 10 = 50

In 3 & 7 = -40

(3 - 7) × 10 = -40

In 7 & 5 = 20

(7 - 5) × 10 = 20

Similarly,

**In 4 & 5 = -10**

**(4 - 5) × 10 = -10**

Hence, the correct answer is **"-10".**

questions.question:
In the question two statements are given, followed by two conclusions, I and II. You have to consider the statements to be true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions, if any, follows from the given statements.

**Statement I:** Some batteries are cells.

**Statement II:** All cells are chargers.

**Conclusion I:** Some cells are chargers.

**Conclusion II:** All chargers are cells.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35924910f33b4a4b5c915ff1314d60135007dade1eebd648569a0ff20432986c.png] 

Conclusion I: Some cells are chargers → Follows (In the above diagram shows there is a relation between cells and charges.)

Conclusion II: All chargers are cells → Not follows (It is possible but not definite)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows ".**
